meta.what: Taxes paid in Russia by Russian subsidiaries of foreign companies while still foreign-owned, by home country (owner), 2018-2026. Revision of companies_all.json + round4a.json taxes (split, history_2018_2020_split): same scope, same per-country layout, with company-level corrections.

series.other_taxes: VAT, excise, payroll, property, customs and other taxes (all taxes minus profit tax)

meta.method: Start from the current series (KSE Institute / B4Ukraine country figures, allocation for the rest, round-4 split and 2018-2020 back-cast). Replace or correct with company-level data where it exists: Raiffeisen (RBI country-by-country tax, AUT), UniCredit (ITA), OTP (HUN), Japan Tobacco International moved from CHE to JPN (owner), seized Unipro (DEU) and Fortum (FIN) removed after April 2023, Bundesbank reinvested earnings raise DEU 2024-2026, PepsiCo and other consumer-goods stayers raise USA 2025, Chinese car makers' slump lowers CHN 2025-2026 (guess). 2026 Jan-Aug = 2025 x 8/12 (Russian profit-tax receipts flat in early 2026) except where company data exist (RBI H1 2026, UniCredit wind-down, OTP). Ranges ~90%.

overlaps: Replaces companies_all.json and round4a.json 'taxes' (split and 2018-2020 history) for the company-tax part; do not add on top. Exit payments, forced discounts and seizures are in company_flows.json: here the taxes of a company stop when it is sold (KSE exited cohort weighted by f, unchanged) or seized (Unipro and Fortum removed from May 2023; Carlsberg/Baltika and Danone Russia, seized July 2023 and sold 2024, stay inside KSE's exited-cohort weighting f = 0.45 in 2023, 0.25 in 2024, which is close to their real half-year 2023 and ~0 in 2024). The exit contribution paid to the budget is not a tax here. Dividends of Russian-owned firms abroad (company_flows item 24) are a different flow. Bank profits: RBI/UniCredit/OTP taxes here are taxes, not the banks' payment-channel role (not counted elsewhere as taxes).
notes: 2026 values are January-August amounts (not annualised). The builder currently computes 2026 as the 2025 rate x 8/12 itself; with this file it should take 2026 directly.

Totals (sum of country centrals) are ~13% above KSE's preliminary in-scope 2025 profit tax (EUR 3.93bn vs 3.47bn) because company results (RBI, UniCredit, OTP, PepsiCo) show higher 2025 taxes than KSE's 2024-share method; KSE 2025 is preliminary and extrapolated for non-filers.

JTI is attributed to Japan (owner Japan Tobacco Inc., one-third state-owned), not Switzerland, following the map's owner rule; Coca-Cola HBC stays with Greece and Philip Morris International with the USA, as in KSE.

Lemana PRO (ex-Leroy Merlin, ~EUR 0.12bn profit tax a year) has been 99.9% owned by a UAE partnership since 2023; KSE still counts it as French and so does the central case; the low case for France excludes it.
Bank taxes (RBI) are IFRS income tax including deferred tax, not cash payments; KSE company figures are close to them.
Comparison field per country uses the global pre-war growth multiplier; the builder applies country trends where reliable, so its effects will differ somewhat.
